scripts.dev: bun run check-env && { bun run dev:server & bun run dev:web; wait; }
scripts.build:server: bun run check-env && cd apps/server && bun run build
scripts.db:generate: bun run check-env && cd apps/server && bun run prisma generate
scripts.db:push: bun run check-env && cd apps/server && bun run prisma db push
